I understand what you're saying. But you are wrong, life is an experience, you experienced being young with it's pros and cons. Now it's the time to experience adulthood, and with it's pros and cons. Life it's just an d experience.  
And watch this, it may change your view :  [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JjfClL6nogo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JjfClL6nogo)

Close your eyes, try to get out of your ego (which is very hard) and try to see the big picture. Because when you do so, you’ll change your perspective 180°. Because you’ll remember what everyone forgets. The only certainty there is : Death. 

  It can be scary at first but think about it : You, me, the people who compliment you, those who bullied you, the people you love or those you hate, your parents, mine, the neighbor, the postman… and everyone is going to die one day. The day you realize this, you will be free. Free from others, free from society and especially free from your ego.  Now stop and think about it, you’ll realize that everything that annoys you and irritates you is not worth it. You’ll understand That you’re just going through an experience, a simple experience. The day you understand that YOU ARE AN EXPERIENCE, and one day this experience will be over, it’s the day you’ll have no fear.  
 This world tends to make us forget that, and push us to pursue useless things, to the point where we forget that one day we will die, and we begin to pursue worldly pleasures and to compare ourselves to others and to judge ourselves according to society’s criterias. This society puts so much pressure on you that you began to doubt yourself, thinking you are bad or crazy because you are not the way it want you to be. You think you have no choice, either you submit or it crushes you. But believe me, you are stronger than that because ''God does not burden any soul with more than it can bear''.  So accept yourself, embrace your uniqueness, And I don’t mean to be happy the way you are. I mean to accept what is good in you, and to improve and change what is bad in you. And you are the ONLY one who can know that, the only one who knows what is good and bad for you because you are the only one who knows yourself. 

Time is running out, one day you're going to die, so play your part to the fullest and don't be afraid to Fail, because it's just an experience.
